heuristics.name: none
heuristics.description: No usable signal from the options; arbitrary pick.

heuristics.name: antonym-pair
heuristics.description: Two opposite options suggest the key is one of the pair (contrast-designed distractor).

heuristics.name: near-synonym-pair
heuristics.description: Two near-synonymous options suggest the key is among them.

heuristics.name: repeated-word
heuristics.description: In two-blank items, a word appearing in two options is likely in the key; pick the coherent one of the pair.

heuristics.name: internal-consistency
heuristics.description: Two-blank option whose halves cohere semantically better than the others.

heuristics.name: contrast-pair
heuristics.description: Two-blank option that forms the cleanest contrast/reversal relation.

heuristics.name: look-alike-pair
heuristics.description: Two orthographically confusable options; the key is likely one of them.

heuristics.name: odd-one-out
heuristics.description: Option differing in valence/register from a cluster of similar options.
